sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 31 points from 14 games, face a trip to Dawley Town on Saturday 31 October at 14:00. The leaders' recent form shows a mixed picture with a loss sandwiched between four wins, leaving them still in a strong position. Sandbach will be looking to bounce back and maintain their advantage over second-placed AFC Bridgnorth.
divisionWide: Tuesday's early kick-off sees Telford Town host Eccleshall, with the visitors in strong form on four consecutive league wins. Saturday's packed schedule features several fixtures with title-race implications: Stafford Town (4th, 26 points) entertain the in-form Allscott Heath (who have won five of their last six), while Eccleshall travel to face Shawbury United. Bilston Town's impressive five-game winning streak could be tested indirectly by results elsewhere. Lower-down battles include Cheadle Heath Nomads v Brereton Social, Foley Meir v Barnton, Market Drayton Town v Crewe, New Mills v Wednesfield Community, Wolverhampton Casuals v Allscott Heath, and Widnes Town v Alsager Town—with several of these sides battling to escape the relegation zone.
